title: Sherman's mother abducted and fetus 'genetically managed'

tellings.quote: And so in 1963 when she was uh when she was um uh had me you know in term um they abducted her again and they uh did the genetic management.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, hired him to talk with aliens, tells a story about his own birth. He says a Captain White told him that his mother had been abducted before, and that in 1963, while she was pregnant with him, she was taken again and the baby was 'genetically managed'. If true, it would mean he was shaped from before birth for that contact work.
